reasoning_trace.value: The paper discusses three categories of optical ISAC: photonics-assisted, distributed optical fiber sensing (DOFS), and channel characteristics. The photonics-assisted technique utilizes polarization interleaving to reduce the need for high-bandwidth devices and simplify digital signal processing (DSP). DOFS combines sensing and communication in a single channel, with the potential to improve spectral efficiency and reduce nonlinear effects. The channel characteristics approach achieves ISAC by monitoring the channel characteristics during optical transmission, such as polarization rotation vector and Mueller matrix, without requiring external devices.
